title: ITU AI Readiness framework 2.0 – 13 dimensions (machine-readable via CrashingGuru/ITUAIReadiness dimensions.json, MIT)
issuer: ITU (report: 'ITU AI Ready - Analysis Towards a Standardized Readiness Framework', Report 2.0, January 2026); JSON by CrashingGuru/ITUAIReadiness (MIT)
text: Dimension 1 — Data/Model Marketplace (data_marketplace). Measures the creation of an ecosystem for startups, B2B, or other value-providers to create services from (un)structured data, expert knowledge base, and general platform, and monetize them. Mapped factors: Data, Open Source and Code. Metrics: d1_m01 Dataset Properties: Properties of datasets (metadata: types structured/unstructured, number of datasets, volume, velocity, variety, quality); d1_m02 Model Properties: Properties of models (metadata: types, size, performance, ML/DL, i/o, training dataset parameters); d1_m03 Data Collection Sources: Location, heterogeneity, number of sources, privacy/trust, synthetic/real world, type of source; d1_m04 Diligence Metrics: License and participation agreement templates for marketplace trust; d1_m05 Marketplace Activity: Number of data producers, consumers, agreements, transactions in the data marketplace; d1_m06 Open Datasets: Number of open datasets, downloads, global citations; d1_m07 Marketplace Participants: Number of active participants and transaction frequencies; d1_m08 Fairness and Bias: Safeguards to manage data bias or data quality risks; d1_m09 Privacy and Security: Privacy-preserving mechanisms, authentication, authorization, just-in-time deletion; d1_m10 Personal Data Standards: Standards on personal data protection; d1_m11 Data Governance: Percentage of datasets under partner agreements, license metrics; d1_m12 Standards-Compliant Formats: Amount of data available in pre-specified standard and interoperable manner; d1_m13 Open-Source Models: Properties of open-source models, openly published weights, number of open-source models by domain
licence: MIT (repository code/data; Copyright (c) 2026 Vishnu Ram OV). Underlying framework: ITU report.

text: Dimension 5 — Level of Integration of AI in Workflows (ai_integration). Measures how well AI is integrated into domain workflows and how many benefits it provides. AI is seen as a tool to optimize different domain workflows. Mapped factors: Standards. Metrics: d5_m01 Automation Level: Level of automation achieved by integrating AI; d5_m02 Benefits: Benefits achieved by integrating AI; d5_m03 Time/Energy Saved: Time and energy saved through AI integration; d5_m04 Efficiency: Efficiency metrics including containment time; d5_m05 Redundancy: Redundancy in AI-integrated systems; d5_m06 Scalability: Scalability of AI techniques; d5_m07 Integration Level: Level of AI integration at design, coding, and evaluation levels; d5_m08 Model Suitability: Discovery and suitability of model and dataset for the workflow; d5_m09 Service Multiplier: Number of AI services for the same set of resources; d5_m10 Quality Improvement: Improvement in quality of services by integrating AI; d5_m11 Scope Extension: Extension of scope and range of services; d5_m12 Cost Reduction: Demonstrable reduction in cost for similar services
